contentAfterToc.text: What Is White Labeling?

children: White labeling is when one business creates a product or service, and another business sells it under its name or brand. For example, if you buy a notebook from a shop, that store prints its name and brand on the notebook. However, the notebook was initially made by a different company. It is what you call white labeling.
